title: Vinted photo sync silently failed for Google Photos/URL-sourced listings
description: GET /listings/{id}/photos/{index} in backend/app/routers/listings.py only handled source=='local'; for source=='google_photos' or 'url' it fell through and returned None, which FastAPI serialized as a 200 OK with JSON body 'null'. The Chrome extension's uploadPhotos() (extension/content_scripts/vinted.js) fetched this via background.js and wrapped the 4-byte 'null' response in a File object, which Vinted's upload widget rejected client-side with a generic 'Something went wrong' - while title/description/price filled fine since those don't touch this endpoint. Fixed by adding proper google_photos and url branches (mirroring the working _load_image_and_thumbnail helper in the same file), plus returning a clear 502 instead of silently swallowing errors. Verified: reproduced the exact null response against the live server (listing 239), then confirmed the fix serves real image bytes end-to-end via a throwaway url-sourced test listing.
close_reason: Fixed in backend/app/routers/listings.py get_listing_photo: added google_photos and url source branches, verified end-to-end

title: Google Photos baseUrl cache is in-memory only, expires ~60min, lost on backend restart
description: backend/app/photo_sources/google_photos.py caches picked media items' baseUrl/mimeType only in an in-process dict (_MEDIA_ITEM_CACHE). Google's baseUrl expires ~60 minutes after it's issued, and the cache is wiped on every backend restart (the dev server runs with --reload, so this happens on every code save). If a listing sits for a while before being pushed to Vinted/eBay, or the backend restarts in between, GET /listings/{id}/photos/{index} now correctly 502s with 'go back and re-scan Google Photos to pick it again' (see lister2-3hx) instead of silently corrupting the upload - but the underlying fragility remains: any Google-Photos-sourced listing can go stale before you get around to posting it. Consider persisting the actual downloaded image bytes to disk (similar to the existing thumbnails/ and vinted_photo_cache/ dirs) at listing-generate time in backend/app/routers/listings.py's generate() / _load_image_and_thumbnail(), so photo serving never depends on Google's baseUrl still being valid or the in-memory cache having survived.
